```artifact
Feature: User Login and Administrator Functions

  As a user, I want to log in to the system with valid credentials
  And as an administrator, I want to manage user credentials and system settings

Scenario Outline: User login and administrator functions
  Given I have a valid user login
  When I attempt to log in
  Then I should access the system

  Given I am an administrator
  When I manage user credentials
  Then I should maintain the system

Examples:
  | User login | Administrator management |
  | Valid | Valid |
  | Invalid | Valid |
  | Valid | Invalid |

Scenario Outline: Administrator functions
  Given I am an administrator
  When I set up users and passwords
  Then I should maintain the system

  Given I am an administrator
  When I set up control file for pincode
  Then I should maintain the system

  Given I am an administrator
  When I create appointment file
  Then I should maintain the system

  Given I am an administrator
  When I view/print invoice
  Then I should maintain the system

  Given I am an administrator
  When I back-ups
  Then I should maintain the system

  Given I am an administrator
  When I archive patient profiles
  Then I should maintain the system

Scenario Outline: Speciality management

  Then I should maintain the system

  Then I should maintain the system

  Then I should maintain the system

  Then I should maintain the system

Examples:
  | Speciality |
  | Valid |
  | Invalid |

  Then I should maintain the system

  Then I should maintain the system

Scenario Outline: Symptom maintenance
  Given I am an administrator
  When I maintain symptoms
  Then I should maintain the system
